items.title: New FTC Text Scam Sends a Fake Photo ID
items.summary: Scammers are texting folks pretending to be FTC employees — and they'll send a photo of a fake government badge to look legit. Their pitch: they can recover money you lost in an earlier scam. It's a cruel twist that targets people who've already been burned.

items.title: Your laptop camera is grainy or dead — the Logitech C920 is the $70 webcam that finally looks good
items.summary: The Logitech C920 is a 1080p webcam with a real glass lens and built-in dual mics, far sharper than almost any built-in laptop camera. Get it at logitech.com or Amazon (search 'Logitech C920') and clip it to your laptop lid or desk — no drivers needed.

items.title: Firefox 152 now summarizes pages and blocks fingerprinting free — update at firefox.com
items.summary: Mozilla Firefox 152 (released July 14, 2026) adds a Smart Window that summarizes and explains any selected text, plus stronger anti-fingerprinting and Private Browsing protections. Get it free at firefox.com, or update in-app at Help > About Firefox.

items.title: Type by talking — Whisper Local runs OpenAI's speech-to-text on your PC for free, no cloud
items.summary: Whisper Local is a free, open-source dictation app powered by OpenAI's Whisper model that types what you say at a hotkey — 100% offline, no subscription, no cloud. Grab it at github.com/drajb/whisper-local (Windows & Mac).

items.title: Your drive is packed and Windows is crawling — TreeSize Free shows exactly what's eating the space
items.summary: TreeSize Free by JAM Software scans your drives and lists your biggest folders by size in seconds. Download it free at treesize.com (the 'TreeSize Free' edition), run it, and sort by size to find the culprit — usually old downloads or a bloated Temp folder.

items.title: North Florida internet acting up? Fast.com (Netflix's free speed test) tells you the truth in 5 seconds
items.summary: When your Lake City connection feels slow, don't guess — open Fast.com in any browser (or the Fast Speed Test app) for a real download-speed number. It's Netflix's free tool, no sign-up, and it shows whether you're actually getting what you pay your provider for.

items.title: 7-Zip Just Patched a Dangerous Flaw — Update Now
items.summary: A serious security hole (CVE-2026-14266) was disclosed in 7-Zip, the free file compressor. Opening a malicious .7z or a bad webpage could let an attacker run code on your PC. Fix: update 7-Zip to version 26.02 (Help → Check for Updates).

items.title: Stop the ads and trackers following you around the web — uBlock Origin is the free blocker that still works on Firefox and Brave
items.summary: uBlock Origin is a free, open-source content blocker that removes ads, trackers, and YouTube ads from your browsing. Install it free from the **Firefox Add-ons store (addons.mozilla.org)** or **Brave's extension library** — the full version runs great on both. (Chrome users get the limited "uBlock Origin Lite" because of Google's Manifest V3 changes, so Firefox or Brave is the move for the real thing.)

items.title: Tired of reusing passwords? KeePassXC is the free offline password manager that never touches the cloud
items.summary: KeePassXC is a free, open-source password manager that stores everything in one encrypted file on your own machine — no cloud account, no subscription, nothing leaving your PC. Download it free from **keepassxc.org/download** for Windows, Mac, or Linux.

items.title: Skip the monthly ChatGPT bill — Jan is the free desktop app that runs AI models on your PC with no internet and no account
items.summary: Jan is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads and runs AI language models entirely on your own PC — no cloud, no login, no subscription. Get it at **jan.ai** for Windows, Mac, or Linux.

items.title: Stop paying for WinZip — 7-Zip zips, unzips, and encrypts any archive for free
items.summary: 7-Zip is a free, open-source file archiver that opens ZIP, RAR, and 7z files and can password-protect them with strong AES-256 encryption. Download it free from **7-zip.org**.

items.title: Shrink that giant video file — HandBrake converts any clip to a smaller size for free
items.summary: HandBrake is a free, open-source video converter that shrinks MP4, MKV, and DVD files without losing noticeable quality. Download it free from **handbrake.fr**.
